verdict.rationale: Asana's docs describe AI Studio (no-code agent/automation builder) and custom AI Teammates built from team expertise, directly supporting user-built custom agents, though these are first-party marketing claims without independent hands-on validation of the builder experience. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on corroboration of AI Studio's agent-building flow, details on depth of customization/configuration options, and evidence distinguishing true custom agent creation from templated no-code rules.
